added_failures_note: measured: both arm logs named by the reviewed manifest's test_logs were read (baseline.log base arm at 427d872af: 96 passed, EXIT=0; after.log head arm at e000241de: 168 passed). Neither log reports a FAILED or ERROR node id, so the symmetric difference is empty and 0 failures were added. The reviewed manifest declared no baseline_suite/after_suite keys, so the arms were taken from its test_logs entries.

findings.text: blocking: the review write path builds its SET clause from a fixed property list, so judge_kind, judgment_model and the three JSON payloads are dropped and a shadow record's score is coerced to 0.0, meaning this node's own done-when arm "a shadow write round-trips" is unmet; the repair is outside this node's granted write paths, so the coordinator must extend the writer in a companion node or re-scope §6.

follow-on: "assert alone == beside" compares two calls of _mirror_batch on the identical _accept_entries() fixture with independent mocks, and the intervening _write_records writes into a throwaway MagicMock, so no shadow record is visible to either call and the assertion cannot redden if the accept path is pointed at a shadow field.

follow-on: the assertion pins the write path's omission of the shadow fields, so this test reddens when the capability is added and stays green while it is absent — an inverted guard recorded as evidence that the shadow payload does not round-trip.

follow-on: the refine guard compares a pure name-level predicate over a state dict before and after adding an unrelated judge_kind key the predicate never reads, so the equality holds by construction and would not redden if a judge kind were introduced into the compared state.
follow-on: the evidence paragraph cites after.log with EXIT=0, but after.log carries no EXIT line.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 427d872af; one commit e000241de, four files, +503/-4, every path inside the declared scope; no generated model staged.
item_verdicts.done_when: plan §6 names three arms; the schema arm holds (imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3806) and the no-reader arm holds for the accept and refine paths, but the "A shadow write round-trips" arm does not — tests/standard_names/test_review_shadow_store.py:161 asserts the write path omits the shadow fields and the manifest records it as a blocker against status: complete.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to store a challenge judge's per-question answers on the review record under a distinct judge kind read by no accepting, refining or exporting path (plan §6); imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py:230 builds and marks such a record, but the graph write path drops all five shadow fields so nothing is stored.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 96 passing at base and 168 at head with the gate logs named, and discloses the write-path blocker, but its tests field states what the schema declares rather than the command that ran and its result.
item_verdicts.write_paths: declared paths are imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml, imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py, tests/standard_names/test_review_shadow_store.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-judgment-evaluation/sje-shadow-store.html; git diff --stat 427d872af e000241de shows exactly those four files.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_review_shadow_store.py:274 reddens when the accept score selection reads judge_confidence_json (negative_control.log, 1 failed / 10 passed), but the mirror-identity assertion at :218 holds whatever the accept path does.
justifications.evidence: baseline.log (96 passed, EXIT=0) and after.log (168 passed) are on disk and the measured delta is 0, but the fragment cites an EXIT=0 marker after.log does not carry.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:3814 spells judgment_model as imas_codex/discovery/paths/scorer.py:84 does and reuses the repository's _json suffix convention; no plan or ticket label appears in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py:230 marks the record jev with score null, but imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:6013 SETs only its fixed property list, so no shadow answer can reach the store.
justifications.reuse: the change extends _build_review_record at imas_codex/standard_names/review/pipeline.py:173, the sole owner of the record builder, and a search over imas_codex for an existing judge-kind discriminator found none.
